notes.title: Update 1.1.0
notes.notes: [h3]Hey everyone![/h3][p]We’ve got a lot to share today, so grab a snack.[/p][p][/p][h2]Soundtrack Release[/h2][p]The Official SkullX: Aibohphobia OST is out![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45583291/e9015d894fc9223cd57c94d5eee881abe7a45959.png"][/img]17 instrumental tracks—50 minutes of gloom, despair, and a dash of electrochemical shock courtesy of our Mysterious Wanderer—all composed by the talented [b]Arthur Farrakhov[/b]. [/p][p]You can check it out right now on [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3958130/SkullX_Aibohphobia__Official_Soundtrack/"]Steam[/url], [url="https://open.spotify.com/album/2gyANgtzIFp6hJhK2uekDD?si=D3i67jGhSeu7e0uFK2lPQw"]Spotify[/url] and all major streaming platforms.[/p][p][/p][h2]Chinese Localization[/h2][p]We’re excited to announce that SkullX is now fully localized in Simplified Chinese![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45583291/9745e1da73afe2a82b937a6316f33aa3f51ac2b3.png"][/img]Huge thanks to our translation partners [b]WeMavin Languages[/b] who wrestled with BBCode monsters and occult riddles to make this possible.[/p][p][/p][h2]Writing Updates[/h2][p]We’ve combed through community feedback and made a round of text and writing edits across the game.[/p][p]Nothing major was rewritten — but certain scenes are now sharper, smoother, and closer to the tone we always wanted.[/p][p][/p][h2]What’s Next in Localization[/h2][p]We’re not stopping with Chinese. [b]Russian[/b], [b]French[/b], and [b]Polish[/b] localizations are already in the works.[/p][p]We’ll share progress updates as we go — and yes, Russian is being handled in-house by our writer.[/p][p][/p][h3]That’s the news for now.[/h3][p]As always, [b]thank you[/b] for playing, sharing, reviewing, and generally being the fuel that keeps our merc squad alive! [/p][p]Keep your eyes peeled — [b]release date for Chapter 2 will be revealed soon[/b]. This is a deal we’ll seal the only way we know how… [b]hellbinding[/b].[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45583291/62886370218efc2875873e2c6c4318c312f67430.png"][/img][/p]

notes.notes: [p][b]Bug Fixes:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed a bug where a specific branch of the story-line didn't \[spoiler] properly apply sanity loss to your mercenary companions \[/spoiler] as intended.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed shadow rendering in combat scenes on macOS. notes.notes: [h3][b]Patch 1.0.9 is live![/b][/h3][p][/p][h3]Bug Fixes: [/h3][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where the game would skip a scene when [spoiler] the player was putting Adam's body aside. [/spoiler] [/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a rare bug that prevented players from selecting the 4th skill after [spoiler] finishing the game with the true ending. [/spoiler] [/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]Improvements: [/h3][list][*][p]Minor performance optimizations.[/p][/*][*][p]Added an option to make combat sprites static — useful for systems that struggle with animated combat sprites.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]Known Issues: [/h3][list][*][p]We're aware of a launch freeze affecting some systems with AMD processors and integrated graphics. notes.title: SkullX: Aibohphobia – New Release Date & Trailer
notes.notes:
[p]Hey everyone,[/p][p]We’ve got a quick update:
[b]SkullX: Aibohphobia[/b] will now launch on [b]June 30th[/b] instead of late May. That’s just three more weeks—and in the meantime, we’ve prepared a brand new trailer to give you a deeper look at what’s coming:[/p][previewyoutube="dMNxdejLIVw;full"][/previewyoutube][hr][/hr][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45583291/3465a9fa74c6bcc8d6903ac38af132cd90586d49.png"][/img][/p][p]The extra time gave us the chance to further flesh out key narrative arcs—and more importantly, lay the groundwork for how they’ll ripple through future chapters.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45583291/fba821e0825d5f7ded82ea8f885440afca2fd9f3.png"][/img][/p][p][b]Aibohphobia[/b] is built around [i]hidden content[/i]—alternate branches, layered puzzles, and decisions that may seem small at first but can set off major narrative consequences later.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45583291/af900a3c73360bb23368cf54c046a465ef6564a4.png"][/img][/p][p]Developing and weaving all of this together takes time, especially as it all ties directly into the structure of upcoming Chapters.[/p][hr][/hr][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45583291/5265c79785fa4046ee1a01e48e46a1d1eb8cc63e.png"][/img][/p][p]Work on [b]Chapter 2[/b] is already underway.[/p][p]The choices you make—and the outcomes you reach—in Chapter 1 directly affect what happens next.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45583291/bfe49359eef9f85f79654b2c4b4b97ed63123c47.png"][/img][/p][p]You won’t always see the consequences right away, but they’re there. And over time, the connections will become clearer. That’s where a lot of the game’s replayability—and surprises—come from.[/p][hr][/hr][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45583291/a52bc80565d8945ff0689a19af6457efcc2a19e9.png"][/img][/p][p]We’re a small team focused almost entirely on development, so visibility is always a challenge.
If you’re excited about the game, [b]wishlist it[/b], [b]share the trailer[/b], or just send a link to a friend who might enjoy this kind of madness.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45583291/0008ff99685e41970b80c5b95923aeddb2cfde27.png"][/img][/p][p]We’re almost there. Thanks for sticking with us! The experience will be worth the wait.[/p][p]– Team SkullX[/p]
